user.title: Add a ReeFi light
user.description: Enter the light's IP address, for example 192.168.1.50.

error.cannot_connect: No ReeFi light answered at that address. Check the IP and that the light is on your network.

abort.already_configured: This light is already added. Its address was updated.

save_schedule.name: Save schedule
save_schedule.description: Changes schedule points and profiles and saves the full settings to the light, as the light's own Save to Unit button does. Fields left out keep their current values.

entry_id.name: Light
entry_id.description: Config entry ID of the light. Needed only when more than one ReeFi light is set up.

points.name: Points
points.description: List of points to change. Each needs index (0–19) and may set name, hr, min, rate (transition minutes), pindex (profile index), master (brightness %) and seasonal (0 or 1).

profiles.name: Profiles
profiles.description: List of profiles to change. Each needs index (0–19) and may set name and ch (nine channel levels, 0–1023).

active_points.name: Active points
active_points.description: Number of schedule points in use (1–20).

quick_look.name: Quick look
quick_look.description: Shows a profile's levels on the light for a set time, then returns to the schedule.

entry_id.name: Light
entry_id.description: Config entry ID of the light. Needed only when more than one ReeFi light is set up.

profile.name: Profile
profile.description: Index of the profile to show (0–19).

resume_schedule.name: Resume schedule
resume_schedule.description: Ends a quick look or manual levels and returns the light to its schedule.

entry_id.name: Light
entry_id.description: Config entry ID of the light. Needed only when more than one ReeFi light is set up.

sync_clock.name: Sync clock
sync_clock.description: Sets the light's date and time from Home Assistant.

entry_id.name: Light
entry_id.description: Config entry ID of the light. Needed only when more than one ReeFi light is set up.

device_action.name: Device action
device_action.description: Runs one of the light's own system functions.

entry_id.name: Light
entry_id.description: Config entry ID of the light. Needed only when more than one ReeFi light is set up.

action.name: Action
action.description: demo, restart, recalibrate_fan, display_toggle (display on/off), cooldown, led_start_test_on or led_start_test_off.

set_seasonal.name: Set light's seasonal shift
set_seasonal.description: Sets the light's own seasonal feature, which shifts sunrise and sunset through the year. Separate from Home Assistant's Seasons.

entry_id.name: Light
entry_id.description: Config entry ID of the light. Needed only when more than one ReeFi light is set up.

sunrise_minutes.name: Sunrise shift
sunrise_minutes.description: Minutes sunrise moves between summer and winter (0–240).

sunset_minutes.name: Sunset shift
sunset_minutes.description: Minutes sunset moves between summer and winter (0–240).

ignore_dst.name: Ignore daylight saving
ignore_dst.description: Leave the shift unaffected by daylight saving time.

schedule_is_summer.name: Schedule is for summer
schedule_is_summer.description: On if the current schedule is the summer solstice schedule, off if it is the winter one.

set_power_check.name: Set power outage check
set_power_check.description: Turns the light's power outage check on or off.

entry_id.name: Light
entry_id.description: Config entry ID of the light. Needed only when more than one ReeFi light is set up.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Turn the check on or off.

ip.name: Device to ping
ip.description: IP address the light pings to detect an outage.

seasonal_configure.name: Configure Seasons
seasonal_configure.description: Changes Home Assistant's GHL-style Seasons settings for the light.

entry_id.name: Light
entry_id.description: Config entry ID of the light. Needed only when more than one ReeFi light is set up.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Turn Seasons on or off. Turning it on the first time stores the current schedule as the longest day.

table.name: Table
table.description: Rows of ["MM-DD", brightness %, day length %], 2 to 48 rows, as percentages of the longest day.

midday.name: Midday
midday.description: Time point times are squeezed toward, as HH:MM (24-hour).

modes.name: Point modes
modes.description: Per-point mode by point index: both (time and brightness), time (time only) or fixed.

seasonal_capture_base.name: Store longest day
seasonal_capture_base.description: Stores the light's current schedule as the longest-day schedule Seasons works from.

entry_id.name: Light
entry_id.description: Config entry ID of the light. Needed only when more than one ReeFi light is set up.

seasonal_apply.name: Apply Seasons now
seasonal_apply.description: Writes today's seasonal schedule to the light now instead of waiting for 12:05 AM.

entry_id.name: Light
entry_id.description: Config entry ID of the light. Needed only when more than one ReeFi light is set up.

set_point_label.name: Set point label
set_point_label.description: Sets the label the card shows for a schedule point. Stored in Home Assistant, not on the light.

entry_id.name: Light
entry_id.description: Config entry ID of the light. Needed only when more than one ReeFi light is set up.

label.name: Label
label.description: Up to 24 characters. Leave empty to show the light's own name.
